description: This file defines Pydantic models for workout-related schemas in a gym management system, including exercises, templates, programs, and their associated entities.

classes.name: ExerciseBase
classes.description: Base schema for exercise details, including name, description, and category.

classes.name: ExerciseCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new exercise, inherits from ExerciseBase.

classes.name: ExerciseOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting exercise data, includes an ID and ORM mode configuration.

classes.name: PaginatedExercises
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of exercises.

classes.name: TemplateExerciseBase
classes.description: Base schema for template exercises, including exercise ID, sets, reps, rest, and notes.

classes.name: TemplateExerciseCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a template exercise, inherits from TemplateExerciseBase.

classes.name: TemplateExerciseOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting template exercise data, includes an ID and template ID, with ORM mode.

classes.name: WorkoutTemplateBase
classes.description: Base schema for workout templates, including name and goal.

classes.name: WorkoutTemplateCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a workout template, includes optional list of exercises.

classes.name: WorkoutTemplateOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting workout template data, includes ID and trainer ID, with ORM mode.

classes.name: PaginatedTemplates
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of workout templates.

classes.name: ProgramCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a workout program, including name, member ID, optional template, and notes.

classes.name: ProgramOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting program data, including IDs, name, member, trainer, and notes, with ORM mode.

classes.name: PaginatedPrograms
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of programs.

classes.name: ProgramDayCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a program day, including day index and name.

classes.name: ProgramDayOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting program day data, including IDs, program ID, day index, and name, with ORM mode.

classes.name: PaginatedProgramDays
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of program days.

classes.name: ProgramDayExerciseCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating an exercise within a program day, including exercise ID, sets, reps, rest, and notes.

classes.name: ProgramDayExerciseOut
classes.description: Schema for outputting exercise within a program day, includes ID and program day ID, with ORM mode.

classes.name: PaginatedProgramDayExercises
classes.description: Schema for paginated list of exercises within a program day.
